PRO_FINAL convergence decision

FINAL_DECISION: OPEN_MEMORY_BOUNDED_K1024

The controller-headroom family should continue through exactly one prospectively carded, memory-admitted, semantics-preserving K=1024 A/RECON rung. The MAPR learner-budget ladder is not opened yet. Host or estimand recasting is deferred until that rung either remains scientifically unresolved or proves technically inadmissible under the bounded implementation route.

This is the smallest direction-local decision authorized by the requested claim ceiling; it does not alter Portfolio lifecycle, priority, capacity, ownership, or investment. 

PROMPT_BODY

Bounded direction conclusion

The current evidence supports the following narrow conclusion:

BCRH-PERSIST is not pointwise optimal on the exact sixteen-world panel, but material panel-wide controller headroom remains unidentified. The current K=1024 materializing-vector implementation is not resource-admitted. That implementation refusal is not evidence against controller headroom, against K=1024, or against the learner family. The surviving search-width explanation should receive one memory-bounded test before the host or estimand is changed.

The accepted R01 result has aggregate lower/upper means 7/960 and 3299/4800, zone-1 0 and 183/320, and zone-2 7/480 and 3853/4800. The single positive world doubles failed-zone delivery from 14/120 to 28/120; the other fifteen worlds provide no witnessed improvement. Thus neither material panel-wide headroom nor host saturation is established. CH-D / HEADROOM_BRACKET_UNRESOLVED is the correct direct scientific observation. docs/research/candidates/variable_n_fleet_churn/VNFC_CONTROLLER_HEADROOM_A_RECON_R01_RESULT_EVIDENCE_20260904.md, §§1, 4, 6, 8, at ref bd85d6dac44a3349109f681dfea5b3114cbe4f0d.

The technical pilot did not observe any target world or endpoint. It exercised only 68,625 of the controlling 2,008,064 possible materialized depth-1 nodes—about 3.42%—while peak_rss_bytes=0 meant unavailable telemetry, not zero memory. It therefore correctly refused the current materialization, but produced no scientific polarity. docs/research/candidates/variable_n_fleet_churn/VNFC_CONTROLLER_HEADROOM_K1024_RSS_PILOT_TECHNICAL_REFUSAL_20260904.md, §§3–6.

The preceding R02 learner result also remains bounded: three 64-update seeds were valid and presentation-safe, but preliminary support was 0/3; signs varied across seeds and strata, and paired held-out N=7 MAPR-minus-BCRH recovery was negative in every seed. That motivates separating controller opportunity from learner exposure, but does not determine the controller optimum. docs/research/candidates/variable_n_fleet_churn/VNFC_BPCR_R02_RESULT_EVIDENCE_20260903.md, Part II, especially §§22 and the final bounded interpretation.

Why the other three decisions are not selected
Alternative	Disposition
RECAST_HOST_OR_ESTIMAND	Premature now. The live alternative named by R01 is delayed-benefit prefixes pruned by the width-256 beam. The wall projection admits a fourfold widening, and the observed resource blocker is specifically the complete expanded-vector representation. A bounded top-K representation can test that alternative without changing the population, estimand, comparator, information law, or claim.
PARK_DIRECTION	Unsupported. Parking applies when no sufficiently specified or feasible decision-relevant object exists. Here the remaining uncertainty, treatment, comparator, population, branch rule, wall cost and resource blocker are all identifiable. The unverified point is implementation admission, which belongs inside the proposed bounded route rather than being treated as scientific absence. Evidence-spec §§6–8 prohibit transferring technical failure into direction polarity.
CLOSE_CONTROLLER_HEADROOM_FAMILY	Contradicted by the evidence ceiling. One legal trajectory already proves nonoptimality of BCRH in one world, while all three physical upper-bound means remain far above 0.10. There is no structural equivalence, impossibility result, or several independent scientific failures sufficient for closure.

The owner-ratified F.6 decision explicitly selected controller-headroom reconnaissance to distinguish re-posing the host from opening the MAPR budget ladder. The accepted R01 intake then selected K=1024 as the smallest fourfold widening, contingent on resource admission, with a worst-case wall projection of 723.80 s; it expressly said resource refusal creates no scientific negative. docs/Claude_docs/reviews/FIRST_WAVE_SECTION11_COMPLIANCE_20260902.md, F.6; VNFC_CONTROLLER_HEADROOM_A_RECON_R01_INTAKE_20260904.md, Decision 2 and “Next discriminator.”

Smallest next object
Identity and evidence class

Proposed object:
VNFC-CONTROLLER-HEADROOM-A-RECON-MEMORY-BOUNDED-K1024-R02

Class: A/RECON

Status: sequential, outcome-informed follow-up to accepted R01—not independent confirmation and not a C object.

Exact question:

On the identical first-primary R02 sixteen-world heldout-N7 panel, does an exactly semantics-preserving, memory-bounded full-tape beam at K=1024 witness failed-zone headroom of at least delta_fail=0.10 above unchanged BCRH-PERSIST in the aggregate and in both failed-zone strata, thereby justifying the already named one-seed MAPR 256/1,024-update budget ladder? If it does not, stop this bounded search family and re-pose the host, population, or estimand without claiming that physical headroom is absent.

This is the smallest discriminator because the unchanged physical upper bounds cannot move: they depend only on the same worlds and unchanged BCRH trajectory. Consequently, under this successor the old CH-B and CH-C conditions cannot newly become true. The only scientifically informative transition is from unresolved lower bounds to a material lower-bound witness; otherwise the bounded search remains unresolved.

Treatment

Treatment: ORACLE-BEAM-FAIL60-K1024-MEMBOUND

The scientific search remains unchanged:

It receives the complete frozen exogenous tape for one world.

It chooses legal physical commands only at post-loss epochs 0, 1, and 2.

Each candidate command advances exactly twenty native ticks.

Candidates are ordered by:

decreasing exact cumulative failed-zone delivered seconds; then

lexicographically increasing complete physical command prefix.

At depths 0 and 1, retain the best K=1024 prefixes.

At depth 2, evaluate every legal continuation and select the largest exact fail_delivered / fail_demand, with the lexicographically smallest complete command history on a tie.

Freeze all endpoint and headroom quantities at sixty post-loss seconds. Complete epochs 3–5 with the same lexicographically smallest legal terminal suffix used by R01; suffix commands remain excluded from ranking and R_fail_60.

The only implementation change is storage discipline:

Replace the complete depth-level expanded vector with an exact fixed-capacity top-K reducer.

Retain at most the current frontier of K, the next frontier of K, and one transient child, plus fixed enumerator scratch.

Use precisely the same total-order comparator as the materialized implementation.

After reduction, sort the retained frontier by that same total order before the next depth.

Preserve candidate enumeration, native stepping, integer endpoint accounting, float64 operations, world RNG, action legality, tie handling and terminal completion.

Because the ranking key is a complete deterministic total order, a fixed-capacity reducer can return the same top-K set as materialize-then-sort. That equivalence is a proposed engineering inference and must be checked prospectively; it is not yet a repository observation.

No comparator is retuned. No oracle is used to modify BCRH or a learner.

Complete causal and exposure trace
Stage	Meaning-preserving trace
Environment event	One unannounced executor loss occurs in one of the two failed-zone strata on an already fixed heldout-N7 world. The native host owns the exogenous tape, demand, obstruction, state transition, legality, safety and service accounting.
Entity/role ownership	The surviving physical roster remains N=7. The search/controller owns only the legal physical command issued at each of epochs 0–2. BCRH owns its unchanged causal command path; neither search nor analysis changes native ownership or agent identity.

Budget, stop rule and resource admission
Quantity	Requirement
Result arms	One: K=1024.
Worst-case panel work	64,289,424 beam expansions and 1,285,788,480 native ticks.
Projected result wall	723.80 s.
Per-invocation cap	2,700 s, checked only between worlds.
Comparator overhead	Unchanged persistent baseline and exactly 96 BCRH decision calls, under the R01 accounting law.
Population stop	Stop only after all sixteen worlds and both baselines are complete. No partial branch.
Adaptation	No outcome-informed width, extra seed, world subset, second result arm, or early success stop.

The resource admission must be prospectively different from the refused pilot:

No full expanded vector. Runtime instrumentation must establish a fixed live-object bound—current frontier ≤1024, next selector ≤1024, one transient child, and explicitly bounded fixed scratch. No container may have capacity proportional to 1961×K.

Finite selector equivalence. Before any target run, compare the fixed-capacity reducer with the old materialize-and-sort reference on result-blind synthetic inventories covering strict ranks, exact ties, prefix ties, rejected candidates and repeated replacements. No formal universal proof or C contract is required.

Capacity-saturating result-blind pilot. Use no R02 target world or coordinate. The pilot must fill both K=1024 frontiers and exercise replacement after saturation. Because live storage is then independent of the total number of candidates, it must report live-capacity coverage rather than the old 3.42% expansion-materialization statistic.

Reliable memory observation. peak_rss_bytes must be obtained from a functioning OS-backed process-memory measurement and be strictly positive. The measured high-water plus the explicit unexercised fixed-storage bound must conservatively remain below 2 GiB.

Fresh central admission. Immediately before the result invocation, physical and effective available memory must each be at least 4,294,967,296 bytes.

Any unavailable RSS, bound at or above 2 GiB, failed 4-GiB admission, projected wall above 2,700 s, or inability to preserve exact selection semantics is BLOCKED_RESOURCE_ADMISSION, not a scientific result.

The old refusal remains valid for the old implementation. It is not repeated or overridden; the new admission tests a prospectively different memory bound.

Engineering scope

The route requires no default-prohibited machinery:

no distributed execution or worker pool;

no checkpoint/resume/retry orchestration;

no scheduler, lease, heartbeat or supervisor;

no hash chain, byte-manifest gate or authority witness;

no registry, plugin architecture or schema framework;

no telemetry beyond wall time, peak RSS and the scientific live-allocation counters;

no edits to historical R01/R02 results or native semantics.

A fixed-capacity top-K selector is scientific computation, not orchestration. The implementation remains subject to:

at most 2,000 new non-test research-code lines;

runner at most 600 lines;

orchestration below 30% of the research diff;

one under-60-second smoke test plus branch and selector-conformance tests;

one focused test pass after editing and one immediately before launch.

These are the applicable research-code boundaries in docs/project/ENGINEERING_SCOPE_SPEC.md, §§3–8.

What technical success cannot establish

Passing the memory admission would establish only that the changed storage representation is resource-admitted and finitely conformant enough to run the A/RECON object.

A complete positive result would establish only a material witnessed lower bound on the named sixteen worlds at K=1024. It would not establish:

the unknown controller optimum, unless a search endpoint equals the physical ceiling;

MAPR learnability or competence;

that 256 or 1,024 learner updates suffice;

stable or seed-general superiority;

arbitrary-N or repeated-churn generality;

transfer, UAV, safety, flight or deployment performance.

A complete unresolved result would likewise not establish BCRH sufficiency or absent headroom.

Four required boundaries

Direct observation versus inference. The R01 fractions, R02 signs and pilot allocation/RSS facts are direct observations. The claim that a fixed-capacity reducer is the smallest plausible exact repair is an inference and remains subject to finite conformance and memory admission.

Scientific result versus engineering conformance. Selector equivalence, live-node bounds, OS RSS and the 4-GiB preflight are engineering conditions. Only the completed sixteen-world L/U measurements are scientific A/RECON evidence. A failed admission has no scientific polarity.

Direction-local advice versus Portfolio action. This decision opens one direction-local object. It does not change the Portfolio’s current ACTIVE/HIGH record or make any lifecycle, priority, capacity or investment decision; those remain Root/Portfolio authority. docs/research/portfolio/PORTFOLIO.md, header policy and variable_n_fleet_churn row.

Historical provenance versus current authority. Accepted R02, R01 and the technical refusal remain historical evidence at their original meanings. The R01 intake’s contingent selection did not register a successor, and the refusal expressly returned the family choice to this convergence node. This PRO_FINAL decision is the present direction-level authority; it does not rewrite prior evidence. docs/research/candidates/variable_n_fleet_churn/DIRECTION.md, “Controller-headroom reconnaissance.”

Exact re-entry condition

Return to em:variable_n_fleet_churn:convergence only upon one of these records:

Valid complete MB1024-A: recommend opening the named MAPR 256/1,024-update B/EXPLORE ladder.

Valid complete MB1024-D: recommend RECAST_HOST_OR_ESTIMAND; retain all controller results as provenance and make no no-headroom claim.

Exact prelaunch blocker: BLOCKED_RESOURCE_ADMISSION, BLOCKED_SEMANTIC_CONFORMANCE, BLOCKED_WALL_CAP, or BLOCKED_ENGINEERING_SCOPE. No scientific decision is formed from that blocker. Because this decision authorizes only one memory-bounded route, an unrepaired blocker at the bounded implementation limit returns the scientific programme to RECAST_HOST_OR_ESTIMAND, not to another uncarded RSS pilot or wider beam.

Strongest readings

Strongest support: the legal zone-2 row-3 trajectory raises native R_fail_60 from 14/120 to 28/120, proving BCRH is not pointwise optimal; the only current implementation blocker is materialization/RSS admission, while the result-blind K=1024 wall projection remains well below the per-arm cap.

Strongest contradiction: fifteen of sixteen K=256 worlds tie BCRH, every zone-1 lower bound is zero, and the preceding 64-update MAPR learner loses to BCRH on held-out N=7 in every seed.

Surviving alternative explanation: the width-256 cumulative-delivery pruning may discard prefixes whose benefit arrives later. Competing explanations—BCRH already being close to the unknown optimum in most worlds, or headroom being localized—remain live and are exactly why a nonpositive K=1024 result maps to recasting rather than scientific closure.
